title: Balochistan Urban Immovable Property Tax Amendment Ordinance 2002

sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Urban Immovable Property Tax Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE V OF 2002
BALOCHISTAN URBAN IMMOVABLE PROPERTY TAX (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE V OF 2002
An Ordinance
further to amend the Baclochistan Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 11th March, 2002]
No. Legis. 2-42/Law/79-IV,
dated 11-3-2002.--The following Ordinance made by the Governor of
Balochistan on 1st March, 2002, is hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.----(1) This Ordinance may be called the Balochistan Urban
-Immovable Property Tax (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Balochistan, Extraordinary, 11th March, 2002]
No. Legis. 2-42/Law/79-IV,
dated 11-3-2002.--The following Ordinance made by the Governor of

2. Amendment of section 2 of
Ordinance V of 1958. In the Balochistan Urban Immovable Property Tax Act,
1958, hereinafter referred to as the said Ordinance, clause (c) of section 2,
shall be deleted.
